about.heading: About the Builder
about.sub: Engineering capital market platforms with a legal scholar's precision.
about.body1: I am Arya Rifki (sugarate), an independent developer and undergraduate law student based in Semarang, Indonesia. I design and build production-grade systems that solve complex data problems in Indonesian capital markets and statutory jurisprudence.
about.body2: My work bridges distributed web crawling, market microstructure auditing, and legal informatics. Every system is built on one core premise: high data integrity, minimal speculative noise, and robust automation.
